blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “Tatay” Elmer Cordero, who was once arrested for staging a protest with the Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Operator Nationwide (Piston) in 2020, was brought to a hospital Tuesday, Sept. 29, the first day of a two-day nationwide transport strike calling out the government over sharp increases in oil prices. Despite his age and health condition, 78-year-old Cordero stood in solidarity with other jeepney drivers hit hard by soaring oil prices. Diesel rose by P8.82 to as high as P106.37 from Sept. 22 to 28, while gasoline increased by P4.88 per liter to P94.11, according to […]...
